options.content:
# Cloudflare Analytics für robin-lorenz.de

Dieses Dashboard nutzt InfluxDB/Flux-Daten aus `cloudflare_analytics` und `cloudflare_analytics_country`.
Stell den Zeitraum oben rechts am besten auf **Last 7 days** oder **Last 30 days**, weil dein Script abgeschlossene Tageswerte schreibt.

spec.title: Weltkarte: Requests nach Land
spec.description: Nutzt Latitude/Longitude-Mapping statt Country-Lookup, damit die Karte zuverlässiger angezeigt wird.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.country != "unknown" and r.country != "XX" and r.country != "T1")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ Country: r.country, Requests: r._value }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Requests"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)

spec.title: Hacker-/Threat-Map nach Land
spec.description: Zeigt Länder mit Cloudflare Threats. Wenn keine Threats vorhanden sind, bleibt die Karte leer.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "robin-lorenz.de")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "threats")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> sum()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      lookup: string(v: r.country),
      value: float(v: r._value)
  }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "threats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.country != "unknown" and r.country != "XX" and r.country != "T1")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ Country: r.country, Threats: r._value }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Threats"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)

requests = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.country != "unknown" and r.country != "XX" and r.country != "T1")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Requests"})
  |> keep(columns: ["country", "Requests"])

threats = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "threats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.country != "unknown" and r.country != "XX" and r.country != "T1")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Threats"})
  |> keep(columns: ["country", "Threats"])

join(tables: {requests: requests, threats: threats}, on: ["country"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      Country: r.country,
      Requests: r.Requests,
      Threats: r.Threats,
      Threats_per_1000_Requests: if r.Requests > 0 then float(v: r.Threats) / float(v: r.Requests) * 1000.0 else 0.0
  }))
  |> sort(columns: ["Threats_per_1000_Requests"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfRequestsAll" or r._field == "cfPageviewsAll" or r._field == "cfUniquesAll")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field:
      if r._field == "cfRequestsAll" then "Requests"
      else if r._field == "cfPageviewsAll" then "Pageviews"
      else "Unique Visitors"
  }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfBandwidthAll" or r._field == "cfBandwidthCached" or r._field == "cfBandwidthUncached")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field:
      if r._field == "cfBandwidthAll" then "Total"
      else if r._field == "cfBandwidthCached" then "Cached"
      else "Uncached / Origin"
  }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfRequestsAll" or r._field == "cfRequestsCached")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _field: "Cache Hit Rate",
      _value: if r.cfRequestsAll > 0 then float(v: r.cfRequestsCached) / float(v: r.cfRequestsAll) * 100.0 else 0.0
  }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.country != "unknown" and r.country != "XX" and r.country != "T1")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ Country: r.country, Requests: r._value }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Requests"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfRequestsAll")
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value, metric: "Requests" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "metric"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.country != "unknown" and r.country != "XX" and r.country != "T1")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ Country: r.country, Bytes: r._value }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Bytes"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)

from(bucket: "robin-lorenz.de")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "threats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "country", "_value"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "robin-lorenz.de")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics_country")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "threats")
  |> group(columns: ["country"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfPageviewsAll")
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value, metric: "Pageviews" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "metric"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfUniquesAll")
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value, metric: "Unique Visitors" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "metric"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfThreatsAll")
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value, metric: "Threats" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "metric"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cloudflare_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cfBandwidthAll")
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value, metric: "Bandwidth" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "metric"])
